title: 19 non-negotiable demands to change the Dark Skies pilot, and NBC's Don Ohlmeyer steps in

tellings.quote: a list of 19 non-negotiable demands of things that had to change in our pilot.

plain: In 1996, the makers of Dark Skies, a television series about UFOs, were handed "a list of 19 non-negotiable demands of things that had to change in our pilot", and then Don Ohlmeyer, an NBC executive, stepped in. The television writer Bryce Zabel, who worked on the pilot, tells this first-hand, from his time in Los Angeles. He tells it together with his writing partner Brent Friedman, who was also there, and he mentions Steven Spielberg along the way. The story shows how much pressure the show was under before it ever aired.
